claim_ceiling_note: Counts here are measured by this tool on the 31 named source files. They assert nothing about semantic meaning, authority or acceptance; an independent verifier must re-run the tool before this becomes evidence.

RULE_PER_LINE.definition: one segment per physical line; a line is the bytes up to and including b'\n', and a trailing fragment without a newline is itself one segment
RULE_PER_LINE.identity: segments == newline_count (+1 only when the file does not end with a newline)
RULE_PER_LINE.unit: physical line (a formatting artefact, not a semantic unit)

RULE_STRUCTURAL_BLOCK.definition: merge every maximal run of adjacent lines sharing one class into a single segment
RULE_STRUCTURAL_BLOCK.unit: same-class line run (a layout block, not a semantic unit either)

precedence: html_comment (inside an open comment, closes on '-->')
code_fence_delim (inside an open fence, line matches ^\s{0,3}(```|~~~)) / blank / text (fence interior)
class_taxonomy.fence_outranks_comment_why: inside a fenced code block a literal '<!--' is code, not markup; v1 tested comment detection first and relabelled those lines html_comment
class_taxonomy.no_fence_body_class: the class vocabulary has no fence_body member, so a fenced block's interior becomes text/blank runs between its delimiters; fence integrity is reported separately (fence_delimiters, fence_open_at_eof)

rule_semantics.per_line_111331: 111,331 是 RULE_PER_LINE 的行段數，不是語意分割數
rule_semantics.structural_is_the_block_count: structural_blocks_sum 才是 RULE_STRUCTURAL_BLOCK 的區塊數
rule_semantics.statement_zh: 111,331 是 RULE_PER_LINE 的行段數（等於 31 個檔案的換行字元總數），不是語意分割數；structural_blocks_sum 才是 RULE_STRUCTURAL_BLOCK 的區塊數。兩個數字都不是語意單元數：一個是排版行，一個是同類行連續區間。
rule_semantics.statement_en: 111,331 is the RULE_PER_LINE line count (= total newline count of the 31 files), not a semantic partition count; structural_blocks_sum is the RULE_STRUCTURAL_BLOCK block count.
rule_semantics.neither_is_semantic: Neither count is a semantic/claim unit count. Do not cite either as 'sections' or 'clauses'.

reconciliation.prior_rule_source: FHS_W0_R7_VERIFY_20261108/lanes/A/A_REPORT.json :: u0_partition.definition.rule_B ('one segment per top-level block: heading line, whole fenced code block (delimiters + body), whole table block, blank-line run, paragraph run')
reconciliation.why: Different rules over identical bytes, not a data disagreement: bytes_sum is 22281767 under both and both tile every byte. The dominant cause is fence granularity. rule_B emits ONE segment per whole fenced block (514 fence blocks), while this tool's class vocabulary has no fence_body member, so a fenced block becomes one code_fence_delim block per delimiter line PLUS the text/blank runs between them: 1021 delimiter blocks + 2022 interior blocks = 3043 blocks where rule_B has 514, i.e. +2529. Countervailing difference: rule_B reports more heading blocks (4547) than there are heading LINES (4335, this tool's per-line count) and more table blocks (831) than this tool (769), so its non-fence classes are not reproduced by the ^#{1,6}+space / leading-'|' predicates used here; that pulls the other way by -1331. Net +1198. Nothing was tuned: the measured number is reported as measured. Two probes make the rule-dependence checkable rather than rhetorical: (a) re-running this tool with a single fence_body class and comments folded into text yields 23687 blocks (--probe-rules), i.e. within 316 of the claimed 24003, and (b) the verifier's own second rule (rule_A, maximal same-class line runs with fence body separate from delimiters) reported 25032 on the same bytes. Three rules, three counts, one byte total.

measured_decomposition.attribution_caveat: the fence term is measured by this tool; the residual bundles the verifier's heading/table/text predicates, which are not byte-for-byte reproducible from its report, so no exact additive attribution to 24003 is claimed

sensitivity_probe.interpretation: shows the count moves by >1k purely from two taxonomy toggles on unchanged bytes; the 24003 claim sits inside the range these rules span

reconciliation.note_on_radius: This tool's 25201 is NOT offered as 'the correct' block count and does not supersede 24003; both must be cited with their rule attached.
